question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution: The erroneous spelling is **"Devide".** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Here, the incorrect spelling of the word "Divide" is given as** 'Devide'.(**विभाजित करना) • The word '**Divide**' means to separate into two or more parts or pieces. • **Example***: The equator **divides **the Earth into two hemispheres.* • *​***Therefore,** the correct answer is **option 4.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** __ • ** Let's understand the meaning of the other given options__** : • **Divine**: connected with God or a god(दिव्‍य, दैवी, ईश्‍वरीय) • **Devote**: to give a lot of time, energy, etc. to somebody/something(किसी काम में बहुत-सा समय और शक्ति लगाना) • **Dive** : the act of diving into water(पानी में गोता लगाने की क्रिया, ग़ोता) 42:Tacc, The correct answer is Option 1
